description: NaBa₂LaTi₄O₁₂ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.78 Å) and four longer (2.81 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.88 Å. La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.71 Å) and four longer (2.81 Å) La-O bond lengths. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.04 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, one La, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Ba and two equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OBa₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent La, and two equivalent Ti atoms.
